modal.editDescription: Modify the DHCPv6 relay service settings.
modal.createDescription: Set up the DHCPv6 relay agent to forward client requests to a centralized server.
modal.listenHelp: Interfaces the relay agent listens on for client DHCPv6 requests. Optionally specify the IPv6 source address to listen on for each interface.
modal.upstreamHelp: Interfaces used to forward DHCPv6 requests to the server. Add one or more server IPv6 addresses per interface.
modal.globalOptionsHelp: Advanced tuning — leave blank to use defaults.
modal.hopCountHelp: Discard relay packets that have reached this hop count (1–255).
modal.interfaceIdHelp: Add an interface-ID option to relayed packets identifying the interface on which the client request was received.
